claim_boundary: Pair-level overlap audit only; no paired corpus is authorized for training until the audit result and a separate frozen selection protocol pass.

method.aggregation: bounded-memory SQLite UPSERT over non-contiguous query blocks; maximum identity retained for each row_hash/development_instance/chain

method.pairwise_rule: exclude only if OAS heavy and light chains both hit chain-matched members of the same development complex
